§6Ferric Schrabidate§f

§aIron meets schrabidium in liquid form. The only way to make dineutronium.§f

§bFerric Schrabidate§f is an iron-schrabidium alloy made by dissolving iron powder into schrabidic acid. It is radioactive and causes blindness like schrabidium. You need this for the §bExposure Chamber§f to produce §bDineutronium§f.

§6Make It§f:
§b•§f Chemical Plant: §e250 mB§f Schrabidic Acid + 1 Iron Powder -> Ferric Schrabidate Powder
§b•§f Smelt the powder into an ingot

§6What It Is For§f:
§b•§f §bDineutronium§f, 8 ingots + Sparkticle Capsule in the Exposure Chamber
§b•§f §bCMB-Schrabidate Laser Crystal§f, enables UV range for the FEL
§b•§f Ferric Schrabidate Anvil, tier 6
§b•§f Dense wire for high-end components

§ePS:§f You will burn through stacks of this. Get your schrabidium-to-acid-to-ferric pipeline running before you touch the Particle Accelerator.
